metric.question_formula: DCG@5 divided by the ideal DCG@5 attainable from that question's present_search_eligible gold sources
metric.aggregate_formula: Unweighted mean over eligible questions; questions with zero present-source gold are excluded and counted.
metric.duplicate_policy: Only the first recommended result bound to a canonical gold source earns gain; every result retains its physical rank.
metric.short_list_policy: Unreturned ranks earn zero; the ideal denominator contains only available present-source gold and is not padded to five.

historical_metric.reason: Its fixed five-slot denominator imposes a sparse-gold ceiling below its 0.70 target on the frozen development and validation cohort.
